title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I have acquired three small pieces of land recently with the intention that these investments will mature in the long run to enable myself to build a house. I am confused about paying zakat on these lands.I would like to know if you purchase land for the purpose of building a house in the distant future may be on the same or some other property by selling this one do you have to pay zakat on it? Is it right for me to pay zakat on selection of them or two of them and mark one as reserved for house building? Also is there a one year grace period before zakat becomes due ? please advise. 2972 views Q. My grandson was given gift, cash and gold since the time he was born in the last 10 years. They are kept in trust for him to enjoy when he atleast 18 years. Is zakat required to be paid on them. 1769 views Q. zakat on invested money 2227 views Q. I simply calculate approximately my zakah 2.5% on the total amount (balance in bank+ current value of the investments in stocks/mutual funds + provident fund balance) currently at the month of Ramadan regularly 2109 views Q. What is the procedure of zakat. 1913 views Q. I have two questions in my mind plz let me clear about the following questions. 1.I had purchased a plot on 03/05/1999 for Rs 1,00,000 for the purpose of business in addition to residential house. 2042 views Q. If a person belonging to syed family wants to give his zakat to his relative who is also a syed. I think zakat should not be given to a syed family person. Hence, he has decided to give his zakat to a non-syed person and get back the zakat amount from him as gift. Then he handed over the gift amount to his syed relative. Is it correct procedure. pl. clarify. 3581 views Q. How to calculate my Zakat 5696 views Q. I have bought a land in the year 2001 for investment purpose. My intention was to sell it and utilize its money for the purpose of building our house whenever we plan to have one since we don?t have our own house yet and are still renting it from outside. Later on, I bought a land and am now building my house on it without selling out the previous land. Now, I have changed my plan to sell that plot and have decided to keep it until, either I decide to sell it or do some sort of business on it. I want to know, (1) Do I have to pay zakat on this land that I bought with the intention to sell and have not sold yet. (2) If so, since when? (3) At what rate per square unit? Kindly advise. 1952 views Q. Zakat on gold 2148 views Q. kis insan par zakat dena kab farz hai? (2) kya har adme ko apni kamai se Rs. 100 me se Rs2.50 ke hisab se paise nikalna zaroori hai . aur ager nahi nikalega to kya wo ganahgar hoga ? (3) agar zakat farz hai to kis hisab se nikalai jayega. quran aur hadith ke hawale ke sath batane ki maharbani kare . jazakallah 50935 views Q. I have one question regarding the interest. When we have a account in the bank, they are giving interest for our money once in three months. 1. Can I use this money? Is it Halal? 2. Can I give this money to my relatives(my sisters and brothers)? 3. Can I give this money to my parents? 4. In Zakath money can I admit my sister's son in the school? (She is poor that she is not able to admit in the school). 2057 views Q. I have some doubts about zakah, kindly advice: I have 2 houses, one I use for my family and ground floor given to rent to my sister 1561 views Q. Would like to know if zakath given to a non moslem who is poor & needy permitted and counts as zakat? before answering our question i would appreciate if you can say & cite the reference from Quraan or Hadith for whatever the answer may be. for whatever replies we have heard from others we have just heard an YES OR NO but no reference from Quran or Hadith. since yr instituition is of repute and renownedness we expect a justifiable answer in reference from the Quraan or Hadith. this will immensely help us. 2405 views Q. zakat 1597 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 9176 Country: India Title: As salaam alai'kum Mufti Saheb, I have accrued interest on my savings account which i would like to give it away without any intention of getting reward, now questions is ? 1. Can i give this to my needy cousin brother .. but what if he is a syed.. coz i heard that we cannot give zakat and interest money to syed's.. 2. My elder brother is deep in debt, can i give it to him.. 3. If not the above 2 then who should i give it to .. Jazakallah Khaire Question: As salaam alai'kum Mufti Saheb, I have accrued interest on my savings account which i would like to give it away without any intention of getting reward, now questions is ? 1. Can i give this to my needy cousin brother .. but what if he is a syed.. coz i heard that we cannot give zakat and interest money to syed's.. 2. My elder brother is deep in debt, can i give it to him.. 3. If not the above 2 then who should i give it to .. Jazakallah Khaire Answer ID: 9176 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2105/1935=D/1429) (1) What your have heared is right; the zakah and interest money can not be given to a syed. (2) If he is not syed you can give to him. (3) You should give it to any poor, needy of zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
